title: grype-tap binary pin
description: The pinned Grype release (req-grype-binary): one version and, per platform, the release archive URL and its sha256. tap_plugin.grype.binary_pin enforces these constraints and additionally requires each URL to be the release archive for the stated version.

description.description: What this file is and how it is maintained.

version.description: The Grype release tag. The only place the version appears.

checksums_url.description: The release's own published checksums file, the source of every sha256 below.

sha256.description: The archive's sha256, copied by the pin tool from the release's published checksums and re-checked against the download.
